subject: Next steps: GSI onboarding itinerary & technical slot alignment
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Lee <tom.lee@cloudgsi.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Dec 2027 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up & proposed itinerary for CloudGSI onboarding

Hi Tom —

Thanks again for the thoughtful discovery this morning. Per our call, I put together a lightweight onboarding itinerary so we can lock in the next two sessions (partner-led demo + technical deep dive with your GSI engineering team). Can you confirm who from CloudGSI will attend the technical deep dive and whether you prefer a US morning or afternoon slot?

Proposed schedule (all ~60–90m):
- Dec 7: Partner-led product walkthrough (overview + marketplace listing ops)
- Dec 9: Technical deep dive (model selection, auth/KMS, VPC connectivity)

Please see the attached intake form (cloudgsi-intake-form.pdf) — if you can fill the highlighted fields (traffic profile, compliance notes, preferred AWS accounts) that will help our infra team scope the session.

Next steps I suggest:
1) Confirm attendees and their roles (PM, Security, Infra)
2) Pick preferred time slots for each session (I listed options inline in the calendar link)
3) Share any procurement timelines we should be aware of

I copied Camila and Jonas to align on the marketplace/ops side and to loop in Vivek for any capacity questions.

Best,
Irene Choi
Director, Partnerships & GTM Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments: cloudgsi-intake-form.pdf
From: Tom Lee <tom.lee@cloudgsi.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Suresh <priya.s@cloudgsi.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Dec 2027 09:08:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up & proposed itinerary for CloudGSI onboarding

Irene — thanks for the recap and the clear plan. Priya and I reviewed the itinerary. Priya will lead the technical deep dive and will bring one infra engineer (Sanjay Kumar) and our marketplace lead (Felicia Dao) for the partner-led session.

Availability:
- Dec 7 (partner walkthrough): 10:00–11:30 PT or 14:00–15:30 PT
- Dec 9 (technical deep dive): 11:00–12:30 PT only

We prefer the earlier windows if possible. I'll route the intake form internally and send a completed copy by EOD Monday. Procurement is on a roughly 6–8 week track — we can share the MSA draft after the deep dive.

Tom
Head of Strategic Partnerships
CloudGSI Solutions

Subject: Re: Follow-up & proposed itinerary for CloudGSI onboarding

Great — thanks Tom. I can own the partner-led walkthrough on Dec 7. Proposed times to match Tom's preference: 10:00–11:15 PT (slot A) for partner walkthrough; Dec 9 we'll reserve 11:00–12:30 PT for the technical deep dive.

Irene, I've attached a brief marketplace runbook and a draft agenda (redwood-onboard-itinerary.xlsx) that maps owner-level asks (docs, listing metadata, billing setup). Jonas, can you confirm if we need any additional account owners from your side for the listing permissions flow? Vivek, flag if capacity/net-new model constraints affect the deep dive timing.

I'll send calendar invites once Tom confirms attendees and Priya confirms Sanjay.

Camila Reyes
Partner Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-onboard-itinerary.xlsx
From: Priya Suresh <priya.s@cloudgsi.com>

Cc: Tom Lee <tom.lee@cloudgsi.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 4 Dec 2027 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up & proposed itinerary for CloudGSI onboarding

Thanks Camila — confirmed on our side. We'll have:
- Dec 7 partner walkthrough: Felicia Dao (marketplace lead) + Tom Lee (partnership), 10:00–11:15 PT
- Dec 9 technical deep dive: Priya Suresh + Sanjay Kumar (infra), 11:00–12:30 PT

I've attached the completed intake form in case you want it before the calendar invite. Also, one ask: Sanjay will need a brief on expected network egress patterns and whether our sandbox accounts should expect outbound IP allowlisting — can someone from infra add a 10–15 minute segment to the deep dive agenda?

Looking forward — will join the invites once created.

Best,
Priya Suresh
Director, Cloud Integrations
CloudGSI Solutions

Attachments: cloudgsi-intake-form-completed.pdf
